narrative.intro: Fedex Supply Chain Distribution System has $405M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Fedex Supply Chain Distribution System won 13 awards so far in the fiscal year, with an average award size of $31.2M. Fedex Supply Chain Distribution System obligations are up 6.3% year over year. Fedex Supply Chain Distribution System has shown consistent growth in contract obligations across recent fiscal years. Obligations by fiscal year are: FY21 $254M, FY22 $253M, FY23 $293M, FY24 $342M, FY25 $381M, FY26 $405M. Fedex Supply Chain Distribution System current-year totals are partial and represent fiscal year to date activity. Fedex Supply Chain Distribution System award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables are total contract values, while the other figures are contract obligations. Fedex Supply Chain Distribution System is active across multiple awards this fiscal year, and the aggregate obligation level places the vendor at a higher spending point than in each prior listed fiscal year.
